title: Online Anti-sexist Speech: Identifying Resistance to Gender Bias in Political Discourse

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting five LLMs with varying levels of instruction (zero-shot, few-shot, roleplay) to classify political tweets directed at UK female MPs into sexist, anti-sexist, or neutral categories. The evaluation compares classification metrics (Precision, Recall, F1) and measures model uncertainty/confidence using perplexity, predictive entropy, and Jensen-Shannon divergence.
